result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back from all the listing and lookup methods you named. The full offline test suite passes, including the new test.

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: a nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: a `description` component at the end of the record. It is null when a promotion has none.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: a new overload of `createPromotion` that takes a description. The existing five-argument method delegates to it with null, so the 50-plus existing call sites are untouched. A blank description is stored as null, the same way blank categories are handled.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert writes the description. Every promotion SELECT, including the one-code lookup, the active-on-date, active-in-region, by-category, best-for-category, and unused-in-period queries, now selects it, and `promotionRow` maps it.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: a new test creates SUMMER with a description and PLAIN without one, then checks the description through the active, category, unused, and code-lookup paths.

I did not change `DemoScenario`, so the demo output is the same as before.
